data.name: Suvankar
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'vankar' meaning conqueror or victorious. It symbolizes the strength and intelligence of a person who is able to overcome obstacles in life.
data.spiritual_meaning: Suvankar is a name that resonates with the energy of victory and strength. It represents the inner power and determination to overcome challenges and achieve success.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates a leader and pioneer, someone who is self-confident and determined. It is a number of action and achievement.

in_sanskrit.name: सुवान्कर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good, auspicious, prosperous, वान् (vān) meaning vehicle, कर (kar) meaning doing. Thus, Suvankar means one who does good and auspicious deeds, one who is victorious and prosperous.
